reason: An installable dsh web GUI theme plugin that adds a green-on-black Matrix theme, configurable decorative digital rain, and related General-settings controls.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 网页界面提供可切换的绿色黑底 Matrix 主题、可调节质量的数字雨背景及相关通用设置。
summaries.en: Adds a selectable green-on-black Matrix theme, configurable digital-rain backdrop, and related General-settings controls to the dsh web GUI.

capabilities: Changes the dsh web GUI color theme and backdrop presentation
Renders a decorative digital-rain canvas in the browser
Adds General-settings controls for theme and rain quality
Persists rain-quality preference in browser localStorage
Registers browser UI and backdrop components through the dsh plugin system
